On a cooperative rush, rules for the planning team
This section explains the steps for the whole desk

Companion Animal Travel Desk Procedures
This section sets the record for intake, handling, and release of animals moving with Aurelia Skyways. Staff shall speak plainly, keep notes current, and use calm, humane methods at every stage.

The passenger coordinator confirms travel documents, carrier condition, and health forms before acceptance. Any concern about fit, ventilation, or behavior is raised at once, with the customer kept informed in respectful language. <<FACT F002>> The desk then logs the animal, the route file, and any care notes, and sends the case to the assigned handler without delay.

Handlers must secure carriers, avoid rough contact, and watch for signs of distress while moving animals through the terminal. Feed, water, bedding, and cleaning supplies are issued as needed, and any irregularity is entered in the record before the shift closes. <<FACT F026>> If a traveler arrives with missing papers, unsafe equipment, or signs of illness, the handler pauses the transfer and calls the senior coordinator for direction.

Staff shall coordinate closely with baggage, security, and arrival teams so the animal remains under proper supervision throughout the handoff. Communication must stay prompt, factual, and courteous, with any special instruction repeated back for confirmation. When release is approved, the desk verifies the destination contact and closes the file only after the animal is safely transferred.

For questions, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor immediately.
